equity.equity_measurement: Prisoner outcomes are compared descriptively with civilians; no civilian figure or difference is given, and prisoners were enrolled in the second quarter only.

notes: Treatment outcomes are proportions with no computed contrast; the primary contrast is against the WHO 85% target, and pair contrasts (new vs retreatment, prisoners vs civilians) also appear. The one unnamed test (p<0.001) is ancillary to diagnosis, and subgroup percentages within culture-positive new patients are restrictions, not stratified analysis. The data collection method for the prospective cohort is not described.
view_issues: Sputum conversion is said to be presented, but no conversion results appear in the text. A 60% retreatment success rate is not possible from six patients, so the denominator must be five or fewer (not stated). The comparison with other DOTS project areas gives no numbers.
